<thought>We have the mass spectrum showing a molecular ion at m/z 141.115 (likely the protonated molecular ion). To narrow down the structure we need more information about the number and types of carbon atoms. The cheapest next step is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will tell us how many distinct carbon environments are present and give clues about functional groups.</thought>
